existing.description: The ITB International Undergraduate Scholarship is a fully funded grant run through Institut Teknologi Bandung's financial aid office for selected young applicants from partner countries in ASEAN, the Asia-Pacific and Africa who want to study at Indonesia's leading technological university. The published package covers the whole S1 degree: full exemption from tuition fees for all eight academic semesters, a monthly living allowance of IDR 4,700,000, a one-time arrival settlement of IDR 10,000,000 to secure private off-campus accommodation, a round-trip economy air ticket at cost to Jakarta, basic health insurance and visa fee coverage. Applicants must hold a 12-year high school diploma with a GPA of at least 3.00 out of 4.00 and IELTS 6.0 or an accepted equivalent, and the university provides no dormitory support.
eligibility: Must be a non-Indonesian citizen (non-WNI) holding a valid passport from one of the designated ASEAN and Asia-Pacific or African partner countries
Must hold a 12-year high school diploma or equivalent official senior high school credentials; anyone already holding or pursuing an S1 degree is ineligible
Minimum cumulative high school GPA of 3.00 out of 4.00

Must provide a valid English proficiency certificate obtained within the last two years: TOEFL ITP 550, TOEFL iBT 63, IELTS 6.0, or an equivalent Duolingo English Test, or official school statements confirming English as the primary medium of instruction
Must submit a certified medical report
Must not be an active military service member
Must demonstrate a clean criminal record verified by home country authorities
existing.eligibility_summary: Non-Indonesian citizens holding a valid passport from a designated ASEAN, Asia-Pacific or African partner country, aged to hold a 12-year high school diploma with a cumulative GPA of at least 3.00 out of 4.00, who are not already holding or pursuing an S1 degree and who meet the English, legal and health requirements.
benefits: Complete exemption from tuition fees (UKT) for all eight academic semesters of S1 study
Recurring monthly stipend of IDR 4,700,000 to cover off-campus housing and general living costs
Upfront initial settlement allowance of IDR 10,000,000 paid upon landing to secure private off-campus accommodation
Round-trip international economy flight at cost from the applicant's home nation capital to Jakarta, including local travel to the ITB Bandung campus
Basic health insurance for inpatient care, outpatient treatment and accidental emergencies in Indonesia, excluding aesthetic care
Visa fee waiver or direct reimbursement for the standard student visa
A compulsory Indonesian language course as part of the ITB curriculum
coverage: 100% tuition fee waiver (UKT) for all eight academic semesters of S1 study
Monthly living allowance of IDR 4,700,000, transferred directly
One-time arrival settlement allowance of IDR 10,000,000, paid on landing
Round-trip international economy air ticket at cost from the capital city of the home nation to Jakarta (CGK), including local travel to the ITB Bandung campus
Basic health insurance covering inpatient care, outpatient treatment and accidental emergencies within Indonesia
Visa fees waived or directly reimbursed for standard student visa application and regulatory processing
requirements: Be a non-Indonesian citizen from a designated partner region and hold a valid non-diplomatic passport valid at least until 31 December 2027
Hold a legalized 12-year high school graduation certificate and transcript documentation
Achieve a cumulative high school GPA of at least 3.00 out of 4.00
Provide an English proficiency certificate obtained within the last two years meeting TOEFL ITP 550, TOEFL iBT 63 or IELTS 6.0, or an accepted equivalent
Obtain a school recommendation letter signed by the principal or a proper counsellor
Record and upload a short personal profile video explaining background, motivation for studying in Indonesia and academic goals at ITB
Submit a certified medical report and evidence of a clean criminal record verified by home country authorities
Register and submit everything through ITB's centralised online financial aid management portal
documents: Valid passport scan - a non-diplomatic passport valid at least until 31 December 2027
12-year high school diploma: legalized high school graduation certificate and transcript documentation
School recommendation letter signed by the principal or proper counsellor from the previous high school
Personal profile video, uploaded as a YouTube link, explaining background, why the applicant wants to study in Indonesia, and academic goals at ITB
Embassy recommendation letter (optional) - a formal recommendation from the Indonesian Embassy (KBRI) or Consulate General in the applicant's country of origin, only if available
All documents scanned into clear digital formats with a maximum file size of 300kb each
existing.english_requirement: TOEFL ITP 550, TOEFL iBT 63 or IELTS 6.0, or an equivalent Duolingo English Test, or official school statements confirming English as the primary medium of instruction; the certificate must have been obtained within the last two years
application_method: Register through ITB's centralised online financial aid management portal, linked from the scholarship page

Complete the application form fields: personal information (full name as in passport, country of citizenship, date of birth, passport number), academic profile and language scores (high school name, cumulative high school GPA, English test type and score), and desired ITB S1 study programmes (first choice, second choice, personal statement video link)
Upload all mandatory documents as scans of at most 300kb each
Include the optional embassy recommendation letter only if one is available
Wait for ITB's finalization stage and the ITB academic and English-language qualification simulation stages, which the page lists as 'Will be informed later'
existing.selection_notes: ITB describes the scholarship as a direct financial support programme for selected young talents from partner countries in ASEAN, Asia-Pacific and Africa, and states that the financial support applies exclusively to the individual awardee and does not account for any family dependencies. Selection is staged: document submission and online registration, a finalization stage, and an ITB academic qualification and English-language qualification simulation. The university states no dormitory or hostel accommodation support is provided, so recipients arrange private off-campus accommodation themselves using the arrival settlement allowance. A compulsory Indonesian language course is part of every undergraduate programme.
existing.best_fit: Non-Indonesian applicants aged to hold a 12-year high school diploma, from ASEAN, Asia-Pacific or African partner countries, with a high school GPA of at least 3.00/4.00 and IELTS 6.0 or an accepted equivalent, seeking a fully funded engineering, science, technology, design or humanities degree at Institut Teknologi Bandung and who can arrange private off-campus accommodation.
existing.notes: The scholarship is described as a fully funded grant, but the tuition component is published as a complete exemption from tuition fees (UKT) rather than a monetary figure, so funding_amount carries the published monthly living allowance. ITB states that the financial support applies exclusively to the individual awardee and does not account for family dependencies. Tuition for repeated courses is not addressed in the ITB publication.
existing.duration: Eight academic semesters of S1 (undergraduate) study, as stated in the published 100% tuition fee waiver for all 8 academic semesters
